component.name: safety-harness
component.description: A perception-grounded safety harness for physical AI: default-deny precondition gate for actuators, permission not detection.

properties.name: safety-harness:dev-tooling
properties.value: Development/test-only tooling (pytest) is required to run tests/ but is not declared anywhere in pyproject.toml (no [project.optional-dependencies] group exists yet) and is not part of the installed runtime distribution; deliberately excluded from this SBOM's components.

properties.name: safety-harness:dependency-philosophy
properties.value: safety_harness/integrity.py describes itself as following 'the same dependency-free rule as the rest of this package'; read literally that overstates the package as a whole -- action_schema.py imports PyYAML unconditionally at runtime, and pyproject.toml correctly declares it. This SBOM lists that one real runtime dependency rather than asserting zero.

components.name: PyYAML
components.description: YAML parser and emitter for Python
